desc: 卸妆产品刺激眼睛，或卸不干净防水睫毛膏时，学会说明问题、比较配方，并询问正确用法。

sceneSetup.en: Aria asks a beauty advisor to help her choose a makeup remover that feels gentle around the eyes and can remove waterproof mascara.
sceneSetup.zh: Aria 请美容顾问帮她挑选一款眼周使用感温和、又能卸除防水睫毛膏的卸妆产品。

learningGoal.en: Explain irritation, compare formulas, and ask how to rinse, cleanse, and emulsify a makeup remover.
learningGoal.zh: 学会说明刺激问题、比较产品配方，并询问冲洗、清洁和乳化方法。

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: Hi again, what are you looking for?
dialogue.zh: 又见面了，这次想找什么产品？

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: I need a gentle makeup remover.
dialogue.zh: 我需要一款温和的卸妆产品。

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: What kind of makeup?
dialogue.zh: 主要卸哪种妆？

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: Mostly foundation and eye makeup.
dialogue.zh: 主要是粉底和眼妆。

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: My current remover doesn't work.
dialogue.zh: 我现在用的那款不太管用。

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: This bi-phase remover is made for eye makeup.
dialogue.zh: 这款水油分离卸妆液是专门用来卸眼妆的。

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: It works well on waterproof mascara.
dialogue.zh: 对防水睫毛膏的效果挺好的。

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: Do I need to rinse it off?
dialogue.zh: 我需要把它冲洗掉吗？

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: It's best to rinse or cleanse afterward.
dialogue.zh: 之后最好冲洗或再次清洁。

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: You could also try a cleansing balm.
dialogue.zh: 你也可以试试卸妆膏。

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: Will the cleansing balm remove waterproof mascara too?
dialogue.zh: 卸妆膏也能卸掉防水睫毛膏吗？

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: Yes, massage it onto dry skin,
dialogue.zh: 可以，先在干燥的皮肤上按摩，

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: add a little water to emulsify it,
dialogue.zh: 加一点水把它乳化，

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: then rinse it off thoroughly.
dialogue.zh: 然后彻底冲洗干净。

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: Which one feels gentler around the eyes?
dialogue.zh: 哪一款用在眼周感觉更温和？

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: The balm has a softer texture.
dialogue.zh: 卸妆膏的质地更柔润。

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: Test both on the back of your hand.
dialogue.zh: 可以在手背上先试试这两款。

dialogue.speaker: Aria
dialogue.en: The balm feels more comfortable?
dialogue.zh: 这款卸妆膏感觉更舒服吗？

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: Sounds good.
dialogue.zh: 好的。

dialogue.speaker: Beauty Advisor
dialogue.en: Remember to emulsify it before rinsing.
dialogue.zh: 冲洗之前记得先把它乳化。

tips.title: a gentle makeup remover
tips.body: A makeup remover described as mild rather than harsh.
tips.bodyZh: 形容卸妆产品温和、不刺激。

tips.title: irritate my eyes
tips.body: A natural way to explain discomfort around the eyes.
tips.bodyZh: 自然说明产品让眼睛感到不适。

tips.title: remove waterproof mascara
tips.body: Use remove when talking about taking off makeup.
tips.bodyZh: 表达卸妆时通常使用 remove。

tips.title: a bi-phase remover
tips.body: A two-phase remover that is mixed before use.
tips.bodyZh: 使用前需要摇匀的水油双层卸妆液。

tips.title: rinse it off
tips.bodyZh: 用水把皮肤上的产品冲掉。

tips.title: a cleansing balm
tips.body: A balm-textured product used to dissolve makeup.
tips.bodyZh: 用膏状质地溶解并卸除彩妆的产品。

tips.title: emulsify it
tips.body: Mix the balm with a little water until the texture changes.
tips.bodyZh: 加少量水，让卸妆膏的质地发生变化。

tips.title: Compare texture safely
tips.body: Ask “Can I test them?” before trying beauty products. Follow the advisor's instructions, use clean applicators, and compare textures on the back of your hand.
tips.bodyZh: 美妆产品的试用方式可能因门店而异。先询问 Can I test them?，再按照店员建议使用干净的试用棒，并在手背比较质地。

tips.title: Describe irritation directly
tips.body: “It irritates my eyes” directly describes discomfort. To compare products more gently, ask “Which one feels gentler around the eyes?”
tips.bodyZh: It irritates my eyes 直接说明产品会刺激眼睛。比较产品时，可以问 Which one feels gentler around the eyes?
